comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
In honor of Atlantis' brief return... Stats:

Axe-type class weapon (obviously)
90 Attack
100 Durability
+1 Swordplay
+1 Sword Mastery
+1 Assault
10k fame to equip.
EX Effect: R15 Stamina Loss Reduction (both for the wielder, and for any fleets they form/join)

You can only create this weapon by first obtaining a Minotaur's Axe (through the methods described on its page), and then by processing it through Transmutation Alchemy (R3 Casting/Alchemy required). It is a difficult item to get, but as it's also the most powerful Stamina Loss Reducing equip in the game, well worth the trouble to hunt down. Cheers.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: What are the ingredients to craft this aside from the Axe? thanks

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Most transmutation alchemy recipes follow this formula:

Base Item
Orichalcum x1
Check (10 million㌦) x5
Special Purchase Bond x5

Unless I'm much mistaken, it's the same for this particular weapon.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: Thank you very much, now I only need to find an Alchemist. Where are those recipes?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Recipe will be found at either of these furniture items once they're installed in your quarters:

Transmutation Alchemy Equipment
Complex Alchemy Equipment

But you also need to complete a few additional steps. Borrowing Yihwa's list from the furniture comments:

In order for the recipe to show up, you need to clear the pre-requisite quests for transmutation.

1. Legend of the Labyrinthos
(Recognition 1, Archaeology 1, Theology 1)
Venice Adventurer's Guild.
(The land charting pre-req that had its requirements nerfed)

2. Chart West Candia and Inland Crete.

3. Land of the Legendary King (Search 1, Archaeology 1, English)
Stockholm Adventurer's Guild.

4. Egypt and Atlantis (English)

5. Go visit your nation's capital. When you get prompted that you got an invitation letter from Paracelsus, you're in the clear.
